release_notes:
- Multi-device support: port selector to switch between connected devices
- Switching devices instantly shows the data last read from that device
- If the active device is unplugged, QA Helper switches to another connected device and shows its data
- Device selector is locked while a read or write is in progress
- Read/Write Device Info and Bluetooth config now use per-device cardo_device_lib sessions
- Clearer BlueSuite/device-session error messages and logging
- More visible blue theme accents
